preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in t)
preconditions.description: The ciphered text `t` consists only of lowercase English letters.
The integer `n` is the length of the ciphered text `t` and satisfies 1 ≤ n ≤ 10 000.
The integer `m` is the number of words in the list and satisfies 1 ≤ m ≤ 100 000.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(w, str) and len(w) > 0 and all(c.isalpha() for c in w) for w in words)
preconditions.description: Each word `w` in the list is a non-empty alphabetic string (uppercase or lowercase).
The total length of all words in the list does not exceed 1 000 000.

postconditions.description: The output `stdout` consists only of alphabetic characters (uppercase or lowercase).
The length of the output `stdout` matches the length of the ciphered text `t`.

postconditions.expression: any(all(c.lower() == t[i] for i, c in enumerate(reversed(w.lower())) for w in sentence.split()) for sentence in [stdout])
postconditions.description: The output `stdout` is a valid sentence composed of words from the input list, where each word in the sentence, when converted to lowercase and reversed, concatenates to form the ciphered text `t` when spaces are removed.

postconditions.expression: all(w in words for w in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: Every word in the output `stdout` (split by spaces) is present in the input list of words.
